description: Accessible Settings panel (dialog) opened from a header gear button, consolidating controls: SFX on/off, SFX volume, reduced-motion app toggle, and language (the existing #12 JA/EN toggle moved in). Persist all settings to localStorage via guarded ddm.* helpers. App-level reduced-motion forces a root class that the CSS reduced-motion rules also key off, while OS prefers-reduced-motion remains the default-on signal. JA/EN parity for all new strings. README asset-license note in both README files.
steps: Settings state + persistence: in packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts add guarded localStorage helpers MIRRORING readOnboarded/writeOnboarded and readStoredLang (try/catch, `typeof localStorage === 'undefined'` guard). Define a `Settings` interface { sfxEnabled: boolean; volume: number; reducedMotion: boolean } (language stays owned by i18n.ts under ddm.lang - do NOT move it into ddm.settings; the panel just surfaces useI18n().lang/setLang). Choose a SINGLE JSON key `ddm.settings` (document this choice in JSDoc). Add `SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY = 'ddm.settings'`, `DEFAULT_SETTINGS = { sfxEnabled: false, volume: 0.5, reducedMotion: false }` (sfxEnabled:false satisfies the muted-by-default autoplay policy), a pure `parseSettings(raw: string | null): Settings` that validates/clamps (uses clampVolume, coerces booleans, falls back to defaults on bad JSON) and is UNIT-TESTABLE, plus `readSettings()` and `writeSettings(s: Settings)` guarded wrappers. Keep parseSettings DOM-free.

Create packages/frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.tsx COPYING the ZukanModal.tsx accessible pattern: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-label from a new i18n `settings.title`; useRef+useEffect to move focus to the first control (or a close button) on mount; onKeyDown Escape closes; Tab/Shift+Tab focus trap via querySelectorAll of focusables within the box ref; the PARENT (App) restores focus to the trigger via a settingsTriggerRef. Controls: (1) SFX on/off as a checkbox input with an associated <label> (aria via htmlFor/id) bound to settings.sfxEnabled; (2) volume as <input type=range min=0 max=1 step=0.05> with aria-label from `settings.volume` AND aria-valuetext showing a percentage (e.g. `50%`), disabled or still editable when SFX off (keep editable, document); (3) reduced-motion as a checkbox bound to settings.reducedMotion with label from `settings.reducedMotion`; (4) language as the JA/EN toggle MOVED here - reuse the exact lang-toggle markup from App.tsx (role=group aria-label, two aria-pressed buttons calling setLang). Each control change calls back to App to update+persist state and takes effect immediately.

App.tsx integration: add a header gear button (⚙) BEFORE/with the existing header-controls, with aria-label/title from new i18n `settings.buttonAria` and visible text from `settings.button`; a settingsTriggerRef; open state; render <SettingsPanel .../> when open; closeSettings restores focus to settingsTriggerRef (mirror zukan). Hold settings in App state initialized from readSettings() (lazy initializer like readOnboarded), with handlers that update state + call writeSettings. Pass {enabled: settings.sfxEnabled, volume: settings.volume} down to BattlePanel and use them in the FEAT-002 sound calls (feed/train/evolve in App; hit/win/lose/draw in BattlePanel). REMOVE the inline lang-toggle from the header (it now lives in the settings panel) - but keep useI18n().lang/setLang behavior and ddm.lang persistence intact (#12 must not regress). Keep 📖 zukan and リセット/reset buttons in the header.

Reduced-motion app toggle wiring: when settings.reducedMotion is true, add a root-level class `force-reduced-motion` (apply to the top-level .app div in App.tsx, or document.documentElement/body via a useEffect - prefer toggling a class on the top .app element or <html> so CSS can key off it). In packages/frontend/src/styles.css, extend reduced-motion handling so the EXISTING animation-stilling rules ALSO apply under `.force-reduced-motion`. Do this WITHOUT deleting or weakening the existing `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` blocks (there are 10). Approach: for each reduced-motion rule-set, add a parallel selector scoped under `.force-reduced-motion ...` (e.g. duplicate the selector list prefixed with `.force-reduced-motion`), OR refactor shared declarations into a class the media query and the forced class both include. Keep OS prefers-reduced-motion as the default-on signal (the @media blocks stay). Verify no existing reduced-motion behavior regresses.

i18n: in packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts add BOTH ja and en for every new key, keeping JA byte-identical for existing keys. New keys (names illustrative - keep consistent): `settings.button`, `settings.buttonAria`, `settings.title`, `settings.close`, `settings.sfx` (SFX on/off label), `settings.volume`, `settings.volumeValue` (optional template for aria-valuetext like `{percent}%`), `settings.reducedMotion`, `settings.language`. JA examples: settings.title='設定', settings.sfx='効果音', settings.volume='音量', settings.reducedMotion='アニメーションを減らす', settings.language='言語', settings.button='設定', settings.buttonAria='設定を開く', settings.close='閉じる'. EN: '設定'->'Settings', '効果音'->'Sound effects', '音量'->'Volume', 'アニメーションを減らす'->'Reduce motion', '言語'->'Language', 'Settings', 'Open settings', 'Close'. Add to BOTH JA_MESSAGES and EN_MESSAGES so the Record<MessageKey,string> type stays satisfied.

Add SettingsPanel + gear button styles to packages/frontend/src/styles.css reusing the zukan-modal / dialog visual language (overlay, box, header, close button, control rows). Style the range input and checkboxes to be visible and keyboard-focusable (focus-visible outline consistent with existing controls).

Add unit tests to packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts for parseSettings (valid JSON round-trips; bad JSON -> DEFAULT_SETTINGS; out-of-range volume clamped via clampVolume; non-boolean sfxEnabled/reducedMotion coerced; missing fields filled from defaults). Import parseSettings/DEFAULT_SETTINGS at the top import block. Keep it DOM-free.

README asset-license note: add a short section to BOTH README.md and README.ja.md stating that sound effects are synthesized at runtime via the Web Audio API and no third-party audio assets are bundled. EN example: 'Sound effects are generated at runtime via the Web Audio API; no third-party audio assets are bundled.' JA example: '効果音は実行時に Web Audio API で合成しており、サードパーティの音声アセットは同梱していません。' Place it near the Overview/features or a dedicated small 'Sound / 効果音' note. Keep both READMEs consistent.
acceptance_criteria: A header ⚙ Settings button opens an accessible dialog: focus moves into the dialog on open, Escape closes it, Tab/Shift+Tab are trapped inside, focus returns to the trigger on close, and all controls have programmatic labels (label/htmlFor or aria-label).

The panel exposes SFX on/off (checkbox), volume (range with aria-valuetext percentage), reduced-motion (checkbox), and the JA/EN language toggle; the inline header language toggle is removed and language still persists under ddm.lang (#12 not regressed).

All settings persist to localStorage under ddm.settings (language under ddm.lang) and take effect immediately: toggling SFX/volume changes what plays; toggling reduced-motion adds/removes the force-reduced-motion root class.

With settings.reducedMotion on, the force-reduced-motion root class stills the same animations the OS prefers-reduced-motion @media blocks do, and the existing @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) blocks are unchanged (OS preference still default-on).
Every new i18n string has both ja and en; existing JA strings are byte-identical; frontend builds with the Record<MessageKey,string> type satisfied.
README.md and README.ja.md both contain the Web Audio no-bundled-audio-asset license note.
parseSettings unit tests pass; frontend test count increases and all pass.
verification: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" && npm test -w @ddm/frontend (expect > FEAT-002 count, 0 failing)
Confirm both README.md and README.ja.md contain the Web Audio license note
findings:
Implemented the accessible Settings panel + persistence, extending (not duplicating) FEAT-002's interim settings source.

ui-helpers.ts: renamed the FEAT-002 DisplaySettings shape to `Settings` and added `reducedMotion: boolean` (DEFAULT_SETTINGS now {sfxEnabled:false, volume:0.5, reducedMotion:false}). Kept `export type DisplaySettings = Settings` back-compat alias. Kept the `ddm.settings` key (SETTINGS_STORAGE_KEY). Added pure, DOM-free `parseSettings(raw: string|null): Settings` (null/invalid JSON/non-object -> fresh DEFAULT_SETTINGS copy; non-boolean sfxEnabled/reducedMotion coerced to defaults; volume clamped via clampVolume; missing fields filled). readSettings() now delegates to parseSettings; added guarded `writeSettings(s)` mirroring writeOnboarded. Language stays owned by i18n.ts under ddm.lang (NOT moved into ddm.settings).

New components/SettingsPanel.tsx: copied the ZukanModal a11y contract exactly (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-label from settings.title, closeBtnRef focused on mount, Escape closes, Tab/Shift+Tab trap via the same querySelectorAll focusables). Controls: SFX checkbox (label/htmlFor=settings-sfx), volume range input min=0/max=1/step=0.05 with aria-label + aria-valuetext percentage (computed from settings.volumeValue template '{percent}%') and a visible value span (kept editable when SFX off, documented), reduced-motion checkbox (label), and the JA/EN lang-toggle MOVED from the header (reuses lang-toggle/lang-btn markup, role=group aria-labelledby, aria-pressed, calls useI18n().setLang). Each change calls onChange (App persists) and takes effect immediately; language calls setLang directly.

App.tsx: replaced the interim per-render readSettings() with reactive state `const [settings, setSettings] = useState<Settings>(readSettings)` + updateSettings (setState + writeSettings). sfxEnabled/sfxVolume now derive from state and still thread into triggerCareFx/evolve useEffect + BattlePanel props (unchanged wiring). Added ⚙ header Settings button (settingsTriggerRef, aria-label/title from settings.buttonAria, text settings.button), settingsOpen state, closeSettings restoring focus to the trigger (mirrors closeZukan). Removed the inline header lang-toggle (now in the panel) and dropped setLang from the useI18n destructure (lang still used for petSpriteLabel/babySpeechText; #12 ddm.lang persistence untouched). Applied `force-reduced-motion` class on the top-level .app div when settings.reducedMotion.

styles.css: left all ten existing @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) blocks UNCHANGED (OS preference stays default-on). Appended a parallel `.force-reduced-motion`-scoped selector set duplicating every one of those stilling declarations (reusing the existing fx-reduced-fade keyframes + zukan-in), plus a .force-reduced-motion .settings-box animation:none. Added settings-btn (zukan-btn pill styling), settings-modal/box/head/title/close (zukan-modal visual language, zukan-in animation), settings-body/row/checkbox/range/range-value with focus-visible outlines.

i18n.ts: added settings.button/buttonAria/title/close/sfx/volume/volumeValue/reducedMotion/language to BOTH JA_MESSAGES and EN_MESSAGES; existing JA strings byte-identical.

game-ui.test.ts: imported parseSettings + DEFAULT_SETTINGS; added 5 DOM-free tests (valid round-trip; null/invalid-JSON/non-object -> defaults; volume clamped; non-boolean flags coerced; missing fields filled). Frontend count 130 -> 135 passing.

README.md + README.ja.md: added a sound/settings feature bullet and a blockquote asset-license note (EN: 'Sound effects are generated at runtime via the Web Audio API; no third-party audio assets are bundled.' / JA: '効果音は実行時に Web Audio API で合成しており、サードパーティの音声アセットは同梱していません。').

Verification: `npm run build` green (tsc + vite). `npm test` shared 152/0. `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` 135/0. Both READMEs contain the Web Audio note. No new runtime deps.
